2608.25646.title: LDAC-Net: A Learnable Multi-Lag Differencing Attention-Convolution Network for Drift-Robust Recognition with Low-Cost MOX Gas Sensors
2608.25646.paper_summary: Portable electronic-nose systems based on low-cost metal-oxide (MOX) gas sensors offer a practical solution for gas and odour recognition, but their signals are affected by slow chemical transients, drifting sensor offsets, scale variation, and cross-channel correlations. Existing pipelines commonly use fixed first-order temporal differencing (FOTD), which requires a manually selected lag and may discard useful response information. We propose LDAC-Net, an end-to-end learnable multi-lag differencing attention-convolution network that operates directly on multi-channel MOX signals. Its learnable differential feature enhancement front-end combines window-conditioned statistical affine normalisation, which compensates for window-specific offset and scale variation, with learnable multi-lag differencing, which weights and combines temporal differences across multiple lags. A compact attention-convolution backbone subsequently models local transients and longer-range temporal dependencies. On the 50-class SmellNet-Base task, LDAC-Net achieves 68.2% top-1 accuracy, exceeding the best FOTD-preprocessed comparison model by approximately 14 percentage points and the raw-input Transformer by more than 30 points. Ablation studies confirm the contributions of both proposed components. The representation also transfers to SmellNet-Mixtures, improving accuracy from 45.4% to 50.5%, and generalises to the 62-channel eNose-Drift benchmark under strong long-term drift, achieving 70.6% top-1 accuracy and 69.6% macro-F1. These results outperform the best comparison model with dataset-retuned FOTD preprocessing by 8.0 and 3.0 points, respectively, demonstrating that learnable, sensor-aware preprocessing is more effective than fixed handcrafted differencing for low-cost MOX gas-sensor recognition.
2608.25646.paper_summary_zh: 可攜式電子鼻系統基於低成本金屬氧化物（MOX）氣體傳感器，為氣體和氣味識別提供了一種實用的解決方案，但其信號受到緩慢化學瞬態、傳感器漂移偏移、尺度變化和跨通道相關性的影響。現有的管道通常使用固定的一階時間差分（FOTD），這需要手動選擇延遲，並可能丟棄有用的響應信息。我們提出了LDAC-Net，一種端到端可學習的多延遲差分注意力卷積網絡，直接在多通道MOX信號上運行。其可學習的差分特徵增強前端結合了窗口條件的統計仿射正規化，補償窗口特定的偏移和尺度變化，與可學習的多延遲差分相結合，對多個延遲的時間差進行加權和組合。隨後，一個緊湊的注意力卷積主幹建模局部瞬態和較長範圍的時間依賴性。在50類SmellNet-Base任務中，LDAC-Net達到了68.2%的頂級準確率，超過了最佳FOTD預處理比較模型約14個百分點，並且比原始輸入的Transformer高出30多個點。消融研究證實了兩個提議組件的貢獻。該表示也轉移到SmellNet-Mixtures，將準確率從45.4%提高到50.5%，並且在強長期漂移下對62通道eNose-Drift基準進行了泛化，達到了70.6%的頂級準確率和69.6%的宏觀F1。這些結果分別比經過數據集調整的FOTD預處理的最佳比較模型高出8.0和3.0個點，顯示出可學習的、傳感器感知的預處理在低成本MOX氣體傳感器識別中比固定手工差分更有效。
